item.title: I Remember

item.title: 2023 Year-End Summary
item.author: xianpeng.shen@gmail.com (Xianpeng Shen)
item.description: Three roles in 2023: a dad, an engineer holding on to DevOps best practices, and a spare-time open-source maintainer and writer. cpp-linter-action passed 400 users, and I wrote 20 blog posts and 6 WeChat articles.

item.title: 2022 Year-End Summary
item.author: xianpeng.shen@gmail.com (Xianpeng Shen)
